_source: Machine-readable mirror of reference/rednote_anti_ai_and_compliance_lexicon.md and the red lines in prompts/03. It encodes this project's own lists; it is not a verified statement of current platform or advertising rules.
_severity: error = unambiguous hit; review = context-dependent, a human or the Stage 5A critic should decide.
_disclaimer_en: These lists are this project's own. They are not legal advice and not a statement of the current rules of Xiaohongshu or any other platform. An entry's basis says what was read and when; an entry without one rests on common practice that was not checked against an official source.
_disclaimer_zh: 这些词表是本项目自己整理的，不是法律意见，也不代表小红书或任何平台现在的规则。每一条的「依据」写明读的是什么、什么时候读的；没有依据的条目来自常见做法，没有对照官方文件核对过。

ad_law.title_zh: 《中华人民共和国广告法》（2021 年修正）
ad_law.title_en: Advertising Law of the People's Republic of China (as amended in 2021)
ad_law.note_zh: 按维基文库上的文本核对。此后有没有再修订，没有核对。这部法律管的是商业广告；一条日常视频里的说法算不算广告，要看具体情况。
ad_law.note_en: Read as published on Wikisource. Whether it has been amended since was not checked. The law governs commercial advertising; whether a line in an everyday video counts as advertising depends on the case.

humanizer_zh.note_zh: 一份针对书面中文的修改清单，它自己说明是「检查线索，不是词语黑名单」。这里只取了放进口播稿里不自然的说法，而且只作为「确认一下」。
humanizer_zh.note_en: A checklist of editing patterns for written Chinese. It says of itself that it gives clues, not a word blacklist. Only wording that is out of place in a spoken script was taken from it, and only as "please check".
